prediction.description: Premature ventricular complexes - frequent ectopic ventricular beats.

findings.name: Heart Rate
findings.explanation: Resting heart rate derived from R-peak intervals. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Rr Mean
findings.explanation: Mean R-R interval; the reciprocal of heart rate. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Rr Sd
findings.explanation: R-R variability; elevated values suggest arrhythmia. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Rr Cv
findings.explanation: Coefficient of variation of R-R intervals (normalised irregularity). Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Rmssd
findings.explanation: Root mean square of successive R-R differences (short-term HRV). Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Pnn50
findings.explanation: Percentage of successive R-R intervals differing by more than 50 ms. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Lf Hf
findings.explanation: Low-frequency to high-frequency power ratio of the HRV spectrum. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Qrs Duration
findings.explanation: QRS complex duration; widening indicates bundle branch block or ventricular origin. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Qt Interval
findings.explanation: Ventricular depolarisation and repolarisation duration. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Pr Interval
findings.explanation: Atrial to ventricular conduction time. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: St Deviation
findings.explanation: ST segment deviation from the isoelectric line at J+60 ms. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: T Amplitude
findings.explanation: T-wave amplitude on the primary lead. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: R Amplitude
findings.explanation: R-wave amplitude; low values can indicate myocardial ischaemia. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Pvc Fraction
findings.explanation: Percentage of premature beats with a wide QRS complex.

findings.name: Rr Irregularity
findings.explanation: Normalised irregularity of the R-R series.

findings.name: Signal Quality
findings.explanation: Signal quality index derived from the noise-to-signal ratio.

findings.name: P Wave Amplitude
findings.explanation: P-wave amplitude - absent P waves are the hallmark of atrial fibrillation. Not measurable in this recording.
